topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution and the Microenvironment
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's learning objectives and frames cancer development as an evolutionary process shaped by cellular and microenvironmental factors.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations provide selective advantages that drive clonal expansion and tumor evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how normal tissue hierarchies and stem cell properties determine tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Influences on Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate that external microenvironmental signals are required alongside mutations to permit the growth of both incipient and established tumors.

topics.label: Technologies for Investigating Tumor Evolution and Microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the experimental and computational tools used in the laboratory to profile tumor heterogeneity and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Integrated Evolutionary Model of Cancer Development
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the lecture's core concepts into an overarching multi-factorial evolutionary framework.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the subsequent lecture on cancer therapy.
